working_memory.text: The Kestrel, a small passenger ferry that has crossed Marrow Sound since 1998, will not sail on Tuesday because its port engine is being replaced. The operator says the work should finish by the weekend, and tickets bought for Tuesday will be honoured on any crossing during the following fortnight. A replacement service by road bus will leave the quay every two hours, taking roughly fifty minutes longer than the boat. Regular commuters have been told to expect crowding on the first two departures.
